longDescription.default: Web parts that integrate with the Bestillingsportalen provisioning solution. Includes the Bestillingsportalen ordering web part (ProjectProvision) for ordering new collaboration spaces, and the InviteGuests web part for inviting external guests to a SharePoint site.

features.title: Bestillingsportalen Provision Web Parts feature
features.description: Registers the Bestillingsportalen Provision Web Parts (ProjectProvision and InviteGuests).
